findings.evidence: isAdmin trusts the client-controlled 'x-admin: yes' header, so any caller can obtain admin access without an authenticated admin session.
webhookOk compares only the first 8 hex characters of the HMAC with signature.startsWith(expected.slice(0,8)), reducing a 256-bit check to 32 bits and ignoring trailing bytes.
invoiceQuery concatenates tenantId and invoiceId directly into a SQL string instead of using bound parameters, allowing cross-tenant data exposure.
overLimit uses requestCount > 6, which permits six requests and blocks the seventh, while the requirement is to block the sixth request in a window.
